deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The ECE department requires GRE scores, and PhD applicants must meet its recommendations.
gre_general.quote: The ECE department requires ETS-reported GRE scores and recommends the following scores

also.quote: Students seeking admission to the Ph.D. program are expected to meet all of the above recommendations and have a graduate GPA of 3.5 or better

toefl_min.value: The ECE department says the campus TOEFL score is 80 iBT or equivalent, above the catalog's 4.5.
toefl_min.quote: The required score set by campus is 80 (iBT) or equivalent.

ielts_min.value: The ECE department accepts an IELTS score of 6.5 when TOEFL is not available.
ielts_min.quote: an IELTS score of ≥ 6.5, a PTE score of 58, or a Duolingo score of 105 is strictly required

entry_route.value: Direct entry from the bachelor's is for exceptional applicants only.
entry_route.quote: Exceptional applicants may apply directly to the Ph.D. program after completing the baccalaureate degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The catalog page states no funding policy.

notes: This record also covers the Computer Engineering PhD, which has the same ECE admission text. The ECE page gives Duolingo 105 where the campus gives 115, and the ECE page allows a 3.5 undergraduate GPA in department coursework to waive the GRE for the MS.
